previous_statement: Apply lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws with the witnesses A,B,k and the two guards established in 1.2 and 1.3. Its polar inverse is the inverse of the same Pi_delta in the root; writing its two components as (u_delta,h_delta), it supplies the asserted C^1 maps, the three exact basepoint identities, and all five displayed approximation/defect estimates with right-hand side A*epsilon_r (with the external lemma's third arbitrary unitary renamed Z).
new_statement: Applying lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws with A,B,k is justified by 1.2 and 1.3 and yields, for the map that external denotes by u_delta, the asserted all-domain C^1 formulas, the three exact basepoint identities, and all five displayed estimates with right-hand side A*epsilon_r (after alpha-renaming its third arbitrary unitary to Z). However, the sole permitted external calls u_delta the inverse of an unspecified 'polar map'; neither it nor the permitted definitions identify that map with Pi_delta(U,H)=U bold-dot H on calU x B_delta^{calH}(J), assert that this Pi_delta is bijective onto S_delta, or supply a second inverse component h_delta. Therefore the root's explicit unique-inverse clause cannot be concluded from the allowed inputs. A contract explicitly giving this Pi_delta its unique two-component inverse, synchronized with the group-law witnesses, must be registered as a dependency, or the root contract must be weakened.
